finalText:
**Migration done.** 36 `db.query` calls in 12 files now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`. `node --check` passes on all of them.

Two calls remain in [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9). Its header says the file is replaced wholesale on upgrade and local edits are lost, so I left it. Left `cache.query` alone too. That is a different object.

Fixing vendor needs an upstream bump or a wrapper. Say the word and I will build the wrapper.
